method: Each LEFT/RIGHT diagnostic crop was inspected visually at readable resolution after deterministic comparison. Raster was used only for this validation, never by extractor or comparator.

pairs.explanation: The layout and connections are visually unchanged; OSPD/camera/room labels change. The comparator finds the value changes and avoids treating l-versus-re command packaging as a structural change.
The dense plan content is visually the same; the slightly different crop height and PDF precision are absorbed only at the 1% guarded tolerance.
The small connection node is visually and exactly vector-identical.
The camera mounting detail and visible table rows match; crop padding and text-span fragmentation differ.
The architecture, annotations and revision marks match visually; one low-level line command and the bbox differ.
The repeated wall sections and labels match; normalization plus 0.5% tolerance removes PDF precision/crop noise.
The plan and system routes match; a few tiny presentation markers and the crop differ, while the embedded-font text is undecodable in both PDFs.

The two engineering systems are geometrically the same, but RIGHT includes an additional notes area and a -0.034 annotation. The comparator returns NEAR_IDENTICAL because the embedded-font text is undecodable and therefore deliberately excluded.
The visible geometry is near-identical, so the status is right, but text/value equality cannot be verified from the broken vector font mapping without OCR or Vision.
The generalized first/n-th outgoing circuits become four explicit QD/Wh/QF branches with changed loads and table content; geometry, topology and text all change strongly.
